sections.text: Resting at Lok's mother's house in Ireland, Scarlet Byrne enlists the Huntik team's help with a mission to find the legendary castle of Tír na nÓg. There, they uncover more secrets while Eathon Lambert coaches Lok on Willblade combat.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''Some Needed Rest'''

[[Lok Lambert]] finds himself in a dream surrounded by [[Harlekin|Harlekins]], and sees [[Eathon Lambert|his father]] in the distance. Lok fights off the [[Titans]] with the [[Willblade]] and makes his way towards [[Eathon]], but gets sucked into a void right before reaching him. Lok then wakes up in [[Lambert house|his childhood house]] in [[County Kerry, Ireland]], and joins the rest of the team as well as [[Sandra Lambert|his mom]] for breakfast.
[[File:S2E48 Cherit Den Sandra.png|thumb|[[Sandra Lambert|Sandra]] talks about her days as a [[Seekers|Seeker]] while [[Cherit]] craves bread]]
[[Dante Vale|Dante]] and Lok discuss how [[Den Fears|Den]] seems to be enjoying himself in the family environment and how the battle against [[Rassimov]] and [[Legion]] took a toll on all of them, both getting flashbacks from losing their respective Titans. Lok wonders if it's his fault for not being able to invoke [[Pendragon]], but Dante comforts him. The rest of the team talk about [[Sandra Lambert]]'s past as a Seeker, and how [[Kathy Lambert|Kathy]] is the only one in the Lambert family unaware of the [[Seekers|Seeker]] world. [[Den Fears|Den]], [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] and [[Cherit]] get into a play fight over a piece of bread, and Kathy walks in through the front door as the two Seekers are using their spells. She is confused about the situation and Dante clears her memory with [[Simplemind]].

In the meanwhile, [[Scarlet Byrne]] is fighting a giant-like Titan with [[Gybolg]], barely being able to take it out. She then joins the team inside the Lambert house, and flirts with Dante, but he doesn't reciprocate. Kathy tells Sophie about this and lets her know there's no need to be jealous. Sandra asks [[Kathy Lambert|her daughter]] to go to town and grab some milk while the team discuss what Scarlet was doing. She reveals she was after [[Tír na nÓg]], a floating castle; however, Scarlet reveals she ended up not seeing anything at the valley she was at. Sandra then tells the story of how Eathon once took her to a nearby valley, and only when the moon broke through the clouds was a floating castle visible.

'''The Floating Castle'''

The team then head to the valley, and [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] reveals how the dreams he's been having took place there. It's not long before the moonlight reveals Tír na nÓg. They get inside the castle with [[Dante Vale|Dante]] warning that they only have until morning to explore. As they get deeper into the castle, they find statues of [[Titans]] similar to the one [[Scarlet Byrne|Scarlet]] encountered, and Lok and [[Cherit]] fall into a void. Dante invokes [[Umbra]] and orders it to find them. 
[[File:S2E48 Kaioh Firbolg Bristlebind.png|thumb|[[Kaioh the Tracker]] is about to take out the first [[Firbolg]] Titan]]
It's revealed that the statues react to Seeker powers, and now the team has to fight against the Titans inside them. Umbra finds Lok and Cherit in [[Inter-dimensional World|a dimension]] that serves as a medium between the human dimension and the [[Spirit World]]. Dante attempts to invoke [[Caliban]], but can't because of exhaustion from the battle against [[Rassimov]]. It's then up to [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]], [[Den Fears|Den]] and Scarlet to fight off the [[Firbolg]] and [[Dullahan]] Titans that emerged from the statues. The fight initially goes their away as they defeat both Titans, but more then come out of their statues.  

'''Pendragon's New Seeker''' 

At the same time, Umbra leads Lok and Cherit to a part of the [[Inter-dimensional World|inter-dimensional world]] with a mirror-like object. Lok then uses [[Eathon Lambert|his father]]'s [[Holotome]] to form a link with him in [[Spirit World|Huntik]] through the mirror. The rest of the team is still struggling against the opponents as their own Titans are taken out and even more Firbolgs and Dullahans appear as Eathon talks with Lok about the latter's failure to invoke [[Pendragon]] when the situation calls for it. Eathon states that Pendragon's owner must be chosen by [[Lord Casterwill]], and tells Lok to remind himself of the first time he held the [[Willblade]] in [[Avalon]]. After struggling for a bit, Lok remembers [[Lord Casterwill|Casterwill]] was there, and in the same instant he appears behind Lok and makes him bond with [[Pendragon|The Legendary Titan of Champions]]. Eathon finishes by warning Lok about the [[Blood Spiral|Spirals]] and how he may need something else other than Pendragon. Lok, Cherit and Umbra are then sent back to the castle where the rest of the team are in the brink of defeat. 
[[File:S2E48 Umbra Lok Willblade Cherit 2.png|thumb|[[Lok Lambert|Lok]] arrives to save the team with [[Pendragon]]]]
At one point, [[Den Fears|Den]] is grabbed by a [[Firbolg]] Titan and [[Scarlet Byrne|Scarlet]] gets knocked back. [[Dante Vale|Dante]], still exhausted, gets in front of her. [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]], despite Dante's warnings, is about to use [[Soulburn]] and invoke [[Phoenix]] just as [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] arrives to stop her. He is able to invoke [[Pendragon]], who easily takes out the enemy [[Titans]]. The statues invoking them then turn into their respective [[amulets]], making Den bond with Dullahan and Scarlet bond with Firbolg. Scarlet thanks the team for the opportunity to be inside [[Tír na nÓg]] and the rest of the [[Seekers]] discuss Lok's talk with his father back in [[Lambert house|his house]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
*In some countries and digital guides, this episode is titled Home Is Where the Titans Are. This is a play on the well-known phrase "Home is where the heart is". 
*Only the French dub gives the full stats of both Dullahan and Firbolg when their Amulets are scanned by the Holotome. In the English dub, the Holotome gives just their type, size and special abilities without giving their attack and defence info. In the Italian dub, the Holotome gives all of Dullahan's stats, but does not mention Firbolg's at all. The missing information across the different dubs was likely cut down due to the episode runtime.

plot_sections.wikitext:
'''Some Needed Rest'''

[[Lok Lambert]] finds himself in a dream surrounded by [[Harlekin|Harlekins]], and sees [[Eathon Lambert|his father]] in the distance. Lok fights off the [[Titans]] with the [[Willblade]] and makes his way towards [[Eathon]], but gets sucked into a void right before reaching him. Lok then wakes up in [[Lambert house|his childhood house]] in [[County Kerry, Ireland]], and joins the rest of the team as well as [[Sandra Lambert|his mom]] for breakfast.
[[File:S2E48 Cherit Den Sandra.png|thumb|[[Sandra Lambert|Sandra]] talks about her days as a [[Seekers|Seeker]] while [[Cherit]] craves bread]]
[[Dante Vale|Dante]] and Lok discuss how [[Den Fears|Den]] seems to be enjoying himself in the family environment and how the battle against [[Rassimov]] and [[Legion]] took a toll on all of them, both getting flashbacks from losing their respective Titans. Lok wonders if it's his fault for not being able to invoke [[Pendragon]], but Dante comforts him. The rest of the team talk about [[Sandra Lambert]]'s past as a Seeker, and how [[Kathy Lambert|Kathy]] is the only one in the Lambert family unaware of the [[Seekers|Seeker]] world. [[Den Fears|Den]], [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] and [[Cherit]] get into a play fight over a piece of bread, and Kathy walks in through the front door as the two Seekers are using their spells. She is confused about the situation and Dante clears her memory with [[Simplemind]].

In the meanwhile, [[Scarlet Byrne]] is fighting a giant-like Titan with [[Gybolg]], barely being able to take it out. She then joins the team inside the Lambert house, and flirts with Dante, but he doesn't reciprocate. Kathy tells Sophie about this and lets her know there's no need to be jealous. Sandra asks [[Kathy Lambert|her daughter]] to go to town and grab some milk while the team discuss what Scarlet was doing. She reveals she was after [[Tír na nÓg]], a floating castle; however, Scarlet reveals she ended up not seeing anything at the valley she was at. Sandra then tells the story of how Eathon once took her to a nearby valley, and only when the moon broke through the clouds was a floating castle visible.

'''The Floating Castle'''

The team then head to the valley, and [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] reveals how the dreams he's been having took place there. It's not long before the moonlight reveals Tír na nÓg. They get inside the castle with [[Dante Vale|Dante]] warning that they only have until morning to explore. As they get deeper into the castle, they find statues of [[Titans]] similar to the one [[Scarlet Byrne|Scarlet]] encountered, and Lok and [[Cherit]] fall into a void. Dante invokes [[Umbra]] and orders it to find them. 
[[File:S2E48 Kaioh Firbolg Bristlebind.png|thumb|[[Kaioh the Tracker]] is about to take out the first [[Firbolg]] Titan]]
It's revealed that the statues react to Seeker powers, and now the team has to fight against the Titans inside them. Umbra finds Lok and Cherit in [[Inter-dimensional World|a dimension]] that serves as a medium between the human dimension and the [[Spirit World]]. Dante attempts to invoke [[Caliban]], but can't because of exhaustion from the battle against [[Rassimov]]. It's then up to [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]], [[Den Fears|Den]] and Scarlet to fight off the [[Firbolg]] and [[Dullahan]] Titans that emerged from the statues. The fight initially goes their away as they defeat both Titans, but more then come out of their statues.  

'''Pendragon's New Seeker''' 

At the same time, Umbra leads Lok and Cherit to a part of the [[Inter-dimensional World|inter-dimensional world]] with a mirror-like object. Lok then uses [[Eathon Lambert|his father]]'s [[Holotome]] to form a link with him in [[Spirit World|Huntik]] through the mirror. The rest of the team is still struggling against the opponents as their own Titans are taken out and even more Firbolgs and Dullahans appear as Eathon talks with Lok about the latter's failure to invoke [[Pendragon]] when the situation calls for it. Eathon states that Pendragon's owner must be chosen by [[Lord Casterwill]], and tells Lok to remind himself of the first time he held the [[Willblade]] in [[Avalon]]. After struggling for a bit, Lok remembers [[Lord Casterwill|Casterwill]] was there, and in the same instant he appears behind Lok and makes him bond with [[Pendragon|The Legendary Titan of Champions]]. Eathon finishes by warning Lok about the [[Blood Spiral|Spirals]] and how he may need something else other than Pendragon. Lok, Cherit and Umbra are then sent back to the castle where the rest of the team are in the brink of defeat. 
[[File:S2E48 Umbra Lok Willblade Cherit 2.png|thumb|[[Lok Lambert|Lok]] arrives to save the team with [[Pendragon]]]]
At one point, [[Den Fears|Den]] is grabbed by a [[Firbolg]] Titan and [[Scarlet Byrne|Scarlet]] gets knocked back. [[Dante Vale|Dante]], still exhausted, gets in front of her. [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]], despite Dante's warnings, is about to use [[Soulburn]] and invoke [[Phoenix]] just as [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] arrives to stop her. He is able to invoke [[Pendragon]], who easily takes out the enemy [[Titans]]. The statues invoking them then turn into their respective [[amulets]], making Den bond with Dullahan and Scarlet bond with Firbolg. Scarlet thanks the team for the opportunity to be inside [[Tír na nÓg]] and the rest of the [[Seekers]] discuss Lok's talk with his father back in [[Lambert house|his house]].
